_doc: S: land-bound 'Special' items; up to 9 per land; spawn only if their lock exists. A: glider and boat are bought items in the special slot.

acquire.A: item vendor; needs Climbing 5 (Hang Gliding point); ~lvl 10
acquire.S: per land via NPC-hinted quest; eagle flight master drops you with a free temporary glider
per land (ocean lands always have one)

reins.name: Reins
rules: riders thrown off at land border

divine-harp.name: Divine Harp (Divine Tune)

acquire.S: per land; may be hidden in a lake

divine-harp.opens: golden iris doors / vaults; doors re-close each new day; usable in water since 0.9.2-0
divine-harp.message: PLAY THE DIVINE TUNE TO UNLOCK SEALED AREAS IN THE <land>

sky-whistle.name: Sky Whistle
sky-whistle.opens: play at bird statue → flock of blue birds lifts you to a floating island with treasure

spirit-bell.name: Spirit Bell
spirit-bell.opens: enter Spirit World for 30 s: ghostly, pass metal portcullis / crypt gates, fog + music

treasure-spirit.name: Treasure Spirit
treasure-spirit.effect: hovers toward nearby hidden treasure (money bags / equipment); treasure counter per land

acquire.S: restless warrior at a Circle of Power; one per participant

iron-lamp.name: Iron Lamp

acquire.A: every item shop stocks ≥1; not craftable

iron-lamp.s-equivalent: innate F lantern; radius via artifacts

flute.name: Flute
flute.effect: play at shrine of life (E) to activate it (respawn + fast travel)

dungeon-keys.name: Keys (gold/silver/copper/boss)
dungeon-keys.effect: open locked dungeons/mansions, gnome cages; kept after opening (0.9.1-6)

books-of-crafting.name: Books of Crafting (Magic/Rare/Epic/Legendary)
books-of-crafting.effect: each unlocks 3-4 recipes of its tier

artifact.name: Artifact / Relic
rules: permanent, cannot be dropped, works in all lands
raises exactly ONE traversal stat: +5% first, x0.9 each next, floor 1% (D6; community saw ~2-5%)
hybrid (D6): also +attack and +max HP with the same diminishing rule (generators.json#design.artifact); 1.0 gave no combat stats
riding/climbing/gliding bonuses reportedly non-functional in 1.0; functional here (D6)
100% realm lore reveals all its artifacts (orange circle marker)
examples: Ring of Momuna (Realm of Vakaa: hang gliding speed)
